infrastructure: Worker terminated without result errors occur through load request before sim/run-episode; per-call failures inside simulator are normally policy-error with partial traces.
isolation/request! attaches worker stderr in ex-data, but development-panel!, episode! and code-panel! retain only getMessage. Underlying timeout/OOM/daemon cause not preserved.
Initial response deadline includes JVM/SCI startup; observed failed controls ~12-15 sec including launch and cleanup. Startup timeout plausible, not established.
fixed FIFO/estimate baselines execute trusted host functions through experiment/panel!, without SCI/Docker. Their completion is not an isolated execution parity comparison.
attribution: evaluate/episode! uses fallback policy hash when execute throws, even after model selected a temporary policy. Use policy/use receipts for selected hash on failed agent episodes.
Direct retained-code and skill-removed controls forbid temporary replacements and retain valid arm attribution.
next_experiment: policy-runtime-diagnostic-v1; proposal only; no inference or sealed reruns
